essence: The verse establishes that the feet have a specified measure in length.
The foot-length is declared to extend up to fifty units measured to the finger-end.
The foot-length in breadth is declared to extend up to the viśvamātrā limit.
The feet may have varied appearances and features, including being with wheels or not inherently so.
The lion-seats must be constructed and placed on top of a lotus seat.
